sources.entry: Multi-Agent Observability by disler - A real-time dashboard that captures Claude Code hook events across concurrent agents — tracing every tool call, task handoff, and lifecycle event through a Bun/SQLite/WebSocket/Vue stack, with session tracking and live filtering.

summary.one_liner: A real-time dashboard that captures Claude Code hook events from concurrent agents and displays them through a Bun server, SQLite storage, WebSocket streaming, and a Vue 3 client.
keywords: watch what my agents are doing
summary.what_it_does: Captures Claude Code lifecycle hook events (12 types, including PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, SubagentStart/Stop, SessionStart/End, Stop, and PermissionRequest) using Python hook scripts run with uv. The send_event.py script POSTs each event to a Bun TypeScript server that stores it in SQLite (WAL mode) and broadcasts it over a WebSocket. A Vue 3 client shows the events in a timeline with multi-criteria filters by app, session, and event type, plus a live canvas pulse chart. The README also describes a chat transcript viewer, emoji labels for tool types, and a time range selector (1m, 3m, 5m). The repo includes a .claude directory with example hooks and agent team definitions that can be copied into other projects.
use_cases: watch every tool call made by parallel Claude Code agents
debug what a Claude Code session did
track subagent start and stop events
review user prompts and session history
spot tool failures and permission requests across agents
how_to_run: Install Claude Code, Astral uv, and Bun (or npm/yarn), and optionally just
Run ./scripts/start-system.sh (or 'just start') to launch the server on port 4000 and the client on port 5173
Open the dashboard in a browser
Copy the .claude directory into your project and replace YOUR_PROJECT_NAME in settings.json with a project identifier
Run ./scripts/test-system.sh or 'just test-event' to check the setup
notable: Covers all 12 Claude Code hook event types with a universal send_event.py forwarder
Live pulse chart with session-colored bars and event-type emoji
Dual color system marking both the source app and the session
Includes example team agents (builder and read-only validator) and a /plan_w_team command
Chat transcript storage and viewer for Stop and SubagentStop events
caveats: Requires several tools installed first (Claude Code, uv, Bun or npm/yarn); the Python hooks need Python 3.11+
Setup means copying the .claude directory into each project and editing settings.json by hand
Several features need optional API keys (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Firecrawl), and the README's TTS and summary features depend on them
The README does not state a license
